collisionProfiles.policy: retain native body/wheel/mirror envelope; broad AABB, continuous oriented contact, bounded slower tangents, explicit support; no implicit saved-policy migration

stagedActorTransaction: actors.transact(updates, accept, stagedVehicleCheckpoint) may persist the complete candidate before synchronously publishing actor and vehicle authority; failures before accept change neither
resolvedContactRoute: oriented-slide-v1 query resolvers return sweeps: 1..70 accepted continuous shapes owned by the vehicle; bounded reachable static candidates and per-segment support; actual intersecting simultaneous routes cancel both substeps without distance charge
yaw: headingRad and steeringRad use right-handed Three +Y rotation; visual +Z is forward; positive yaw turns left from behind; normalized positive steering requests right and converts once to negative wheel yaw

cameraFrame.limits: finite x/y/h and heading within +/-1e6; conservative envelope sides <=128 metres; identities match occupied road transport
cameraFrame.policy: default follow is elevated behind body heading for driver/passenger; overview stays explicit; on-foot uses its existing camera; no velocity flip or saved camera authority

clock: borrowed phased host clock; 0 <= step <= 0.1 seconds, internal bounded substeps <= 0.05 seconds
